scope: A frozen held-out-load probe on the five validation CADs; no final-test CAD fields are opened.

linear_basis.selection: minimum validation15-case mean all-original-node physical displacement vector relativeL2

load_dependent_basis.selection: minimum validation15-case mean all-original-node physical displacement vector relativeL2

stress.selection: minimum validation case_mean_relative_l2; train/test/dia do not select

locked_config.checkpoint: best.pt selected only by ver/hor/tor validation case-mean physical relative L2
locked_config.scalers: Serialized train-only scales; no refitting at evaluation

predeclared_metrics: all-original-node signed displacement vector relative L2: case mean, worst and pooled
displacement RMSE in mm and maximum node-vector error norm in mm
oracle source displacement superposition residual for the metadata-derived ver/hor/tor coefficients
raw signed stress relative L2 and top1-percent |truth| hotspot error from the independent frozen stress model
interpretation: This tests an unseen combination within the observed three-dimensional load span, not a new independent load direction or full six-component loading.
Internal linearity is an architectural property; source FEM superposition must be measured separately.
Only displacement is linearly composed. Stress uses independent predictions and original source labels.
Keep all five final-test CAD field archives excluded. No architecture, coefficients, scaler, seed or checkpoint may be adjusted using this probe.
activation_rule: Root changes status to frozen and records completed summary/config identities and selected best steps only after both training jobs complete. Evaluator refuses planned status before opening held-out fields.
